test_title: SSC CPO 2025 Official Paper (Held On 11 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
A sentence is provided in indirect speech. From the four given options, choose the one that most accurately conveys the sentence in its corresponding direct speech.

He mused that, were the glacier to retreat another kilometer, the valley ecosystem could irrevocably shift.

options.text: He mused, "If the glacier retreats another kilometre, the valley ecosystem could irrevocably shift."
He mused, "Were the glacier to retreat another kilometre, the valley ecosystem could irrevocably shift."
He said, "If glacier retreated another kilometre, ecosystem would shift."
He mused, "Had the glacier retreated another kilometre, ecosystem could shift."

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Indirect Speech:** He mused that, were the glacier to retreat another kilometer, the valley ecosystem could irrevocably shift.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **Subjunctive Mood:** The phrase "were the glacier to retreat" uses the subjun
